entry.title: Sapien: A Stateful Policy Engine for Autonomous AI Agents

link.title: Sapien: A Stateful Policy Engine for Autonomous AI Agents

entry.summary: Contextual security defenses prevent AI agents from taking rogue actions by synthesizing a task-specific policy and enforcing it on the agent’s tool calls. In multi-step tasks, however, which actions are valid often depends on what the agent has already done and learned. We present Sapien, a policy engine for enforcing stateful contextual policies. entry.title: ContinuousBench: Can Differentially Private Synthetic Text Improve Capabilities?

link.title: ContinuousBench: Can Differentially Private Synthetic Text Improve Capabilities?

entry.summary:
We built ContinuousBench, a benchmark for whether DP synthetic text retains the corpus-specific knowledge that motivated using a sensitive dataset in the first place. Existing benchmarks like IMDB and OpenReview are saturated — train-on-real beats no-training by only a few points (51% → 62% on OpenReview, 94% → 97% on IMDB), leaving no room to distinguish DP synthesis methods.
